ME Glass Cable is the basic building block of any AE2 network. It carries power and up to 8 channels per cable segment.

Available in 16 colors for color-coded networks. Different colors do not connect to each other, which lets you run parallel networks on the same physical cable line without interference.

Use a Color Applicator to recolor cables after placement. The default is Fluix-colored.

Every device on the network consumes channels from the cable it connects to. Count your devices and plan your cable routes accordingly. Hit 8 channels on a glass cable and you need to upgrade or branch.

§ePS:§f Glass cables are transparent so you can see channel usage indicators. Handy for debugging.
